t: What Power Plant Performance Database Is All About
title: What Power Plant Performance Database Is All About
description: Power plant performance is efficiency × availability × cost: combined-cycle gas hits 60%+ thermal efficiency; coal plants run 33-40%; nuclear refuels every 18-24 months at 90%+ capacity factors. Heat rate (BTU/kWh) is efficiency inverted; capacity factor is actual vs maximum output. Emissions — CO2, NOx, SO2, mercury — complete the comparison. This database is the complete power plant record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
